translation_direction: en → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete English electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose; the drafting system conducted the current full assessment, with a correlated full-text peer pass from the same AI system. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, full source/target comparison and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: French window is rendered as a large glazed opening extending to floor level, preserving the passage into the garden that the final entrance requires; it is not treated as an ordinary raised window.
Changed tối hẳn to đến lúc trời đã nhá nhem for quite dusk. The source denotes twilight, not complete darkness; repeated evening waiting and the later deepening dusk remain coherent.
Replaced the English-shaped một mẩu chú ý with chút chú ý, retaining the hostess’s limited attention without an unnatural Vietnamese noun pairing.
Changed phải nằm suốt đêm to phải qua đêm: the source says that the man spent the night in a grave and does not specify that he lay down.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.draft_rendering: khung cửa kính lớn, kéo dài xuống tận sàn
alternatives: cửa kính kiểu Pháp thông ra vườn
glossary.rationale: The opening must allow the hunting party to walk through; an ordinary raised window would make the physical action misleading.

glossary.source_term: nerve cure / nerves / lose their nerve
glossary.draft_rendering: điều dưỡng thần kinh / thần kinh / mất vía
alternatives: tĩnh dưỡng / tinh thần / hết hồn
glossary.rationale: Preserve the nervousness motif without inventing a modern psychiatric diagnosis. The closing dog story recycles the weakness the girl has already observed.

glossary.draft_rendering: Bertie, sao anh cứ nhảy cẫng lên?
alternatives: Bertie, sao anh cứ nhảy lên thế?
glossary.rationale: Keep the exact recognisable Vietnamese refrain at its two appearances; the returning voice supplies the crucial sensory confirmation in the visitor’s false frame.
Romance means imaginative fabrication here, not a love affair. The final sentence stays brief; its more explicit Vietnamese verb is a minor period-register tradeoff.

witness_decision: Selected only the complete29-paragraph THE OPEN WINDOW section of the1914 John Lane witness transcribed in PG269. The original newspaper publication is bibliographic context, not a second text silently mixed into the source.

unresolved_questions.explanation: Vietnamese chị/em and cô/cháu supply a fluent address register where English leaves the sister’s age and aunt’s exact genealogical side unspecified. These choices are not asserted as additional facts about the characters.

Bịa chuyện keeps the fabrication and compact final reveal, but is more explicit than the genteel period sense of romance. The short, dry concluding sentence preserves the joke while some lexical ambiguity is necessarily reduced.

title_review.rationale: Cửa sổ để ngỏ is a natural Vietnamese title for the window deliberately left open in the central story. It retains the concrete object and open state without announcing deception or ghosts. The prose specifies the tall glazed opening reaching the floor, so characters can walk through it without an invented climb.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: Compared all introductory exchanges and narrator asides: age15, self-possession, nervous retreat, letters, silence, stranger’s limited knowledge and timing of the alleged tragedy.

Compared the floor-length opening, October warmth, three hunters, bog, lost spaniel, white waterproof, teasing refrain, faltering performance, aunt’s entrance and diverted attention. Source uncertainty is not replaced with advance confirmation that the account is false.
Compared the medical aside, suppressed yawn, tea, girl’s acted horror, twilight figures, coat position, repeated song, cyclist, household exchange, Ganges/grave fabrication and one-line ending.
